metadata.description: Context-aware queries for developer-centric ROS package search evaluation
metadata.note: All queries reference actual packages from the knowledge graph (90 ROS 2 packages)

queries.query: I'm using nav2 for autonomous navigation. What localization packages are compatible with nav2?
queries.rationale: These localization packages integrate with nav2 stack

queries.query: I have ros2_control running with diff_drive_controller. What sensor packages can provide odometry input?
queries.rationale: IMU and sensor fusion packages that work with ros2_control

queries.query: My robot uses gazebo_ros2_control for simulation. What controller plugins are compatible?
queries.rationale: ros2_controllers that work with gazebo_ros2_control

queries.query: I'm building a mobile robot with RPLIDAR A1. What SLAM packages support this 2D LIDAR?
queries.rationale: SLAM packages that work with 2D LIDAR sensors

queries.query: I use ackermann_steering_controller for my car-like robot. What path planning algorithms work with Ackermann steering?
queries.rationale: Planners that handle Ackermann steering constraints

queries.query: I have a RealSense D435 depth camera. What packages can I use for object detection and tracking?
queries.rationale: Perception packages that work with depth cameras

queries.query: I'm using robot_localization for sensor fusion. What IMU drivers can provide input to it?
queries.rationale: IMU packages that publish compatible messages for robot_localization

queries.query: My navigation stack uses geometry2 for coordinate transforms. What packages depend on tf2?
queries.rationale: Major packages that require tf2 for coordinate transformation

queries.query: I want to add AprilTag detection to my mobile robot. What camera packages work with apriltag_ros?
queries.rationale: Camera drivers that publish image topics for apriltag_ros

queries.query: I'm using joint_trajectory_controller for my robot arm. What motion planning frameworks integrate with it?
queries.rationale: Motion planning packages that use joint_trajectory_controller

queries.query: My robot has both a 2D LIDAR and a depth camera. How can I merge these laser scans?
queries.rationale: Packages for merging and converting scan data

queries.query: I'm using clearpath_control for a Jackal robot. What simulation packages work with Clearpath robots?
queries.rationale: Simulation packages compatible with Clearpath robots

queries.query: I have a FLIR thermal camera. What ROS packages support FLIR camera integration?
queries.rationale: FLIR-specific camera drivers and message definitions

queries.query: I'm using behaviortree_cpp for robot behavior control. What navigation packages integrate with behavior trees?
queries.rationale: Nav2 uses BehaviorTree.CPP for navigation behaviors

queries.query: I need to control a bicycle-model robot. What steering controllers support bicycle kinematics?
queries.rationale: Controllers specifically designed for bicycle kinematics

queries.query: My robot uses effort_controllers for joint control. What force/torque sensor packages can provide feedback?
queries.rationale: Sensor packages that provide effort feedback

queries.query: I'm using andino_navigation for a small mobile robot. What SLAM package is compatible with Andino?
queries.rationale: SLAM packages tested with Andino robot platform

queries.query: I have an Axis network camera. What ROS packages can stream video from network cameras?
queries.rationale: Drivers for network-based cameras

queries.query: I'm using nav2_costmap for obstacle detection. What costmap layers can I add for better performance?
queries.rationale: Additional costmap layers for nav2

queries.query: I need to smooth my navigation paths. What path smoothing algorithms work with nav2?
queries.rationale: Nav2 path smoother plugins

queries.query: I'm using admittance_controller for compliant manipulation. What force sensors are compatible?
queries.rationale: Force/torque sensors for impedance control

queries.query: I want to replace cartographer with a faster SLAM solution. What are lighter alternatives?
queries.rationale: Lighter-weight SLAM alternatives to Cartographer

queries.query: I have ArUco markers in my environment. What packages can detect and use them for localization?
queries.rationale: Packages that can fuse ArUco detections with localization

queries.query: I'm using position_controllers for my robot joints. What trajectory planners generate position commands?
queries.rationale: Planners that output position-based trajectories

queries.query: My Autoware stack needs perception messages. What packages define Autoware-compatible message types?
queries.rationale: Autoware message definition packages

queries.query: I need an event camera for high-speed motion. What ROS packages support event camera processing?
queries.rationale: Packages for event-based camera processing

queries.query: I want to visualize my Cartographer SLAM results. What visualization packages work with Cartographer?
queries.rationale: RViz plugins for Cartographer visualization

queries.query: I'm using velocity_controllers but need smoother motion. What are better control alternatives?
queries.rationale: Controllers with trajectory smoothing capabilities

queries.query: I need to integrate automotive-grade navigation messages. What message packages support automotive standards?
queries.rationale: Automotive-specific message definitions

queries.query: My robot needs lifecycle management for reliability. What packages implement ROS 2 lifecycle nodes?
queries.rationale: Packages for managing node lifecycles and monitoring
